mainEntity.name: Can a homeowner DIY an in-law suite or is a licensed general contractor required?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a functional, legally compliant in-law suite requires professional design, structural work, and permitted trades. The project involves drafting architectural layouts, pulling municipal permits, pouring foundations, framing walls, and running dedicated electrical circuits and plumbing lines for the bathroom and kitchen. Cutting corners without permits can create serious safety hazards, void homeowners insurance coverage, and cause complications when selling your home. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms provides experienced project managers and trade artisans who oversee the entire build from initial site review to final drywall finishes and plumbing fixture installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A licensed contractor is strongly recommended due to structural requirements, mandatory building permits, and complex trade work for plumbing, electrical, and framing.
